Generate only:
normalize_model_identifier(value: str) -> str
Input must be a str and not bool, otherwise ValueError. Strip surrounding whitespace, collapse every run of internal whitespace to one ASCII space, and return the result. Empty normalized value raises ValueError. Do not alter non-whitespace characters, including /, :, -, ., and Unicode. Standard library only; no filesystem/network/global state.
Examples: "  qwen3.5:35b  " -> "qwen3.5:35b"; "NVFP4 / Qwen  30B" -> "NVFP4 / Qwen 30B".
Return only Python artifact, no explanation.
